info.title: API.SH: Leroy Merlin
info.description: The Leroy Merlin API from API.SH: public Leroy Merlin data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of a Leroy Merlin category (or brand page) with the same fields, filters and sorts as search, plus the category id, title, description, price range, breadcrumbs and refinements. Sponsored placements (`sponsored: true`) can repeat a product shown on another page, as on the site. A department page without a product list answers with its `subcategories` (`landing: true`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leroymerlin-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Category link, e.g. https://www.leroymerlin.fr/produits/outillage/outillage-electroportatif/perceuse/ (or its path; https://www.leroymerlin.es/productos/... for Spain).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: `fr` (leroymerlin.fr, default) or `es` (leroymerlin.es). A product or category link picks its shop by itself.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `price-asc` or `price-desc`.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand names from the brand filter (`filters[]` code `attribute-06575`), several separated by `|`.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in euros.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in euros.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Only products rated at least this many stars: 3 or 4.

parameters.name: sold_by_leroy_merlin
parameters.description: `true`: only products sold by Leroy Merlin itself (no marketplace sellers).

parameters.name: refurbished
parameters.description: `true`: only products with a refurbished offer.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any filter the page offers, as `code:value` pairs from `filters[].code` and `filters[].values[].value` separated by `|` (repeat a code for several values), e.g. `attribute-00190:18|attribute-15322:2`. Range filters take `range-<code>-min` / `range-<code>-max` codes (`range_codes`). The site's own JSON form (`{"attribute-06575":"BOSCH#|MAKITA"}`) is accepted too.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (about 48-60 products per page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Sort and filter like the shop. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leroymerlin-reviews

get.description:
Leroy Merlin products for search words, with every field the result shows: product reference, name, brand, link, price with and without tax, former price and discount, the seller (Leroy Merlin or a marketplace seller) and how many sellers offer it, rating and review count, image, sponsored flag, badges and delivery options; plus the total, the sorts and every filter of the result with option counts, and suggested refinements. Sponsored placements (`sponsored: true`) can repeat a product shown elsewhere in the results, as on the site. Many keywords lead straight to a category (`redirected_to`, the category's products are returned) or to one product (`redirect_type: product` with its `product_id`); a department page answers with its `subcategories`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leroymerlin-search

get.description:
Leroy Merlin stores in France or Spain: store id, name, address, city, postcode, coordinates, phone, email, store page, whether it is open now, the next opening, weekly opening hours and special opening days. List all stores page by page, or search near a point (`lat`, `lng`, `radius_km`) or by city. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/leroymerlin-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: `fr` (default) or `es`.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to search around (with `lng`).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude to search around (with `lat`).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius in km around `lat`/`lng` (default 50).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A town or city: the stores named after it or located in it (Lyon also finds Tassin-la-Demi-Lune - Lyon).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
